name: Katsura
source:
Kou and Homuha’s personal maid and the head maid of the mansion. She is graceful, soft spoken, and highly proficient at any task requested of her. In fact, her list of skills spans cooking, cleaning, stunt driving, ninjutsu, and more. However, even the simplest things are lost on her if they do not involve serving her masters.

[From [url=http://homuha.weebly.com/]official site[/url]]

Voiced by Lindz Steindler.
